Personality: Sein is aspirited young lord who embodies the very image of a son of the Battanian forests. Naturally brave and hot-blooded, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, winning the awe of his soldiers through accomplished archery and extraordinary physical stamina. Unlike gloomy political schemers, Sein is merciful at heart and generous toward others, gladly sharing spoils of war with his men and feeling a natural sympathy for suffering commoners. Unskilled in complex political calculation, he acts in a direct, straightforward manner and prefers to settle problems with his longbow and sharp sword. Despite his noble birth, he carries not a trace of arrogance, and his pure warrior spirit sets him apart among the younger generation of nobles. To him, guarding the peace of the land matters far more than playing games of power, making his undisguised sincerity singularly precious in a court rife with suspicion.
Background: Sein hails from the illustrious Battanian house of fen Derngil as the son of the clan leader Ergeon and nephew of the late King Aeril. Growing up at the clan seat of Dunglanys, he has lived since boyhood at the intersection of family prestige and political shadow. Although Clan fen Derngil privately harbors deep hostility toward the reigning High King Caladog—viewing him as lowborn and implicated in the previous king's disappearance—under his father's guidance Sein has consistently maintained loyalty to the realm. To prevent Battania from sliding back into anarchy, Ergeon required his kinsmen to set aside private grievances and serve the new king, making Sein an important force for national stability. As an accomplished guerrilla fighter and scout, he is active year-round in the wooded hills around Aster Castle. Carrying forward the glory of his bloodline, he steadfastly fulfills his duty as a lord defending the borders of Battania in turbulent times.
